items.title: After WhatsApp, Telegram submits reply on username feature notice; both submissions being examined
items.description: Submissions of both WhatsApp and Telegram are currently being examined by the government, sources told PTI.

items.title: Premium housing demand, urbanisation to support India's realty market in H2 2026: Knight Frank

items.title: Vivo to hive off its manufacturing unit to its JV firm with Dixon Technologies
items.description: The government on Wednesday approved Vivo Mobile India's application to form a joint venture with Dixon Technologies.
